methods.label: Enumerate coin outcomes
methods.explanation: There are 4 equally likely outcomes in total. Of these, (heads, tails) and (tails, heads) satisfy the condition. The probability is \(2/4=1/2\).
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary enumeration and the Grade 9 equally likely outcome model.
